name: classname-slider
blurb: Carousel with opacity fade in/out based on snap position using dynamic class names.
description: Embla carousel using ClassNames plugin to apply Tailwind classes based on snap state. Snapped slides show full opacity; in-view slides fade to 20% opacity. Includes dot navigation buttons.
use_when: Carousels where visual focus needs to shift—deemphasizing out-of-view items via opacity.
avoid_when: When all slides should remain equally visible.
a11y: Dot buttons provide navigation; keyboard support depends on Embla configuration.
